create_composed_dataset: create a ComposedDataset that combines multiple base datasets with shared augmentations and track generation
build_tuple_concat_dataset: build a TupleConcatDataset that supports tuple indexing across concatenated PyTorch datasets
get_dataset_sample: get a data sample from ComposedDataset by passing a tuple of sequence index, number of images, and aspect ratio
apply_color_augmentation: apply color jitter augmentation to image sequences with optional shared or per-frame jittering
sample_point_tracks: sample a subset of point tracks from a dataset batch with replacement or without replacement based on availability
